name: MIT DSpace
description: MIT DSpace (DSpace@MIT) is the Massachusetts Institute of Technology open-access repository for research articles, technical reports, theses, and datasets.

name: Harvard DASH
description: DASH (Digital Access to Scholarship at Harvard) is Harvard University's central open-access repository for articles, theses, dissertations, and other scholarly output.

name: Stanford Digital Repository
description: The Stanford Digital Repository preserves and publishes Stanford University research outputs, including datasets, theses, and departmental collections, with persistent PURL identifiers.
status_notes: canonical_url uses the SDR persistent URL service (purl.stanford.edu).

name: CaltechTHESIS
description: CaltechTHESIS is the California Institute of Technology thesis repository, providing open access to doctoral and masters theses, including digitized pre-digital works.

name: Deep Blue Documents
description: Deep Blue Documents is the University of Michigan repository for research and scholarly output, including articles, technical reports, theses, and datasets.

name: IDEALS
description: IDEALS is the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign institutional repository, publishing articles, theses, dissertations, technical reports, and research data.

name: eScholarship
description: eScholarship is the University of California open-access repository operated by the California Digital Library, serving publications and data from all ten UC campuses.
publisher: California Digital Library, University of California

name: SMARTech
description: SMARTech is the Georgia Institute of Technology institutional repository for theses, dissertations, papers, datasets, and other scholarly and administrative documents.

name: The Ohio State University Knowledge Bank
description: The Knowledge Bank is the Ohio State University institutional repository for theses and dissertations, journal articles, technical reports, and university publications.

name: Academic Commons
description: Academic Commons is Columbia University's repository for scholarly work by its faculty, students, and staff, including articles, conference papers, theses, and datasets.

name: ScholarSphere
description: ScholarSphere is Penn State's institutional repository for research outputs such as datasets, articles, and media, with persistent identifiers for deposited works.

name: Purdue e-Pubs
description: Purdue e-Pubs is Purdue University's open-access publishing platform for journals, conference proceedings, working papers, and other campus scholarship.

name: DukeSpace
description: DukeSpace is Duke University Libraries' repository for research and educational materials, including theses, datasets, articles, and open course materials.

name: NASA Technical Reports Server
description: NTRS is the public archive of NASA aeronautics and space research literature, including technical reports, journal articles, conference papers, and citations.

name: TSpace
description: TSpace is the University of Toronto's institutional repository for research and teaching materials, including theses, dissertations, articles, and faculty publications.

name: UBC Open Collections
description: UBC Open Collections provides access to University of British Columbia theses and dissertations, digitized historical materials, photos, and open educational resources.

name: UWSpace
description: UWSpace is the University of Waterloo's institutional repository for theses, dissertations, and research publications from across the university.

name: eScholarship@McGill
description: eScholarship@McGill is McGill University's repository for theses, dissertations, and research output, with open access where rights permit.

name: Papyrus
description: Papyrus is the institutional repository of the Université de Montréal, holding theses, dissertations, and research articles from its departments and research units.

name: Apollo: University of Cambridge Repository
description: Apollo is the University of Cambridge institutional repository for research publications, theses, and datasets, supporting open access to Cambridge research.

name: Oxford University Research Archive (ORA)
description: ORA is the University of Oxford research archive, holding publications, doctoral theses, and research data from across the university under open-access policies.

name: UCL Discovery
description: UCL Discovery is University College London's open-access repository for research articles, book chapters, conference papers, theses, and datasets.

name: Spiral
description: Spiral is Imperial College London's institutional repository for research publications, theses, and other scholarly output of the college.

name: LSE Research Online
description: LSE Research Online is the London School of Economics repository for research articles, book chapters, working papers, and other output by LSE researchers.
publisher: London School of Economics and Political Science

name: Edinburgh Research Archive (ERA)
description: ERA is the University of Edinburgh's research archive, providing open access to theses, dissertations, and research publications of the university.

name: Enlighten: University of Glasgow Research Publications
description: Enlighten is the University of Glasgow's research repository, publishing records and, where possible, open full texts of Glasgow research publications and theses.

name: WRAP: Warwick Research Archive Portal
description: WRAP is the University of Warwick's research archive portal for publications, theses, and datasets, with open access where rights permit.

name: ePrints Soton
description: ePrints Soton is the University of Southampton's research repository for articles, conference papers, theses, and datasets across all faculties.

name: ETH Research Collection
description: The ETH Research Collection is ETH Zurich's repository for research publications, theses, and datasets, integrated with the university's publication reporting.

name: Infoscience
description: Infoscience is EPFL's platform for recording, publishing, and preserving the scientific output of the institution, including articles, theses, and technical reports.

name: ZORA
description: ZORA (Zurich Open Repository and Archive) is the University of Zurich's repository for publications, theses, and research data, with open access where possible.

name: TU Delft Repository
description: The TU Delft Repository publishes the research output of Delft University of Technology, including journal articles, theses, books, and datasets.

name: Ghent University Academic Bibliography
description: The Ghent University Academic Bibliography records publications by Ghent University researchers and links to open full texts where available.

name: DIGITAL.CSIC
description: DIGITAL.CSIC is the open-access repository of the Spanish National Research Council (CSIC), holding publications, datasets, and other research outputs of CSIC centres.

name: HAL open archive
description: HAL is the French national open archive where researchers from universities and research organizations deposit publications, theses, and datasets, with an open API.
publisher: Centre pour la communication scientifique directe (CCSD)

name: DiVA academic archive
description: DiVA is the shared academic archive of a consortium of Swedish universities and research institutes, publishing theses, dissertations, and research publications.

name: HELDA
description: HELDA is the University of Helsinki's open repository for research publications, theses, and other scholarly output of the university community.

name: University of Tokyo Repository
description: The University of Tokyo Repository is the university's institutional repository, providing open access to theses, journal articles, and other research output.

name: KURENAI
description: KURENAI is the Kyoto University Research Information Repository, providing open access to theses, articles, and university publications.

name: HKU Scholars Hub
description: The HKU Scholars Hub is the University of Hong Kong's repository for research output, including articles, theses, conference papers, and datasets.

name: Minerva Access
description: Minerva Access is the University of Melbourne's institutional repository for research publications, theses, and datasets, with open access where rights permit.

name: Research Space
description: Research Space is the University of Auckland's repository for theses, dissertations, and research publications from across the university.

name: OUR Archive
description: OUR Archive is the University of Otago's research repository, holding theses, articles, and other scholarly output with open access where possible.

name: OpenUCT
description: OpenUCT is the University of Cape Town's open-access repository for theses, dissertations, research articles, and datasets from UCT researchers.

name: SUNScholar
description: SUNScholar is Stellenbosch University's research repository for theses, dissertations, and publications, supporting open access to South African research.

name: PubMed
description: PubMed is the National Library of Medicine database of citations and abstracts for biomedical literature from MEDLINE journals, life science journals, and online books.

name: PubMed Central
description: PubMed Central is the free full-text archive of biomedical and life sciences journal literature at the National Library of Medicine, including deposits made under funder public-access policies.

name: Europe PMC
description: Europe PMC is a life science literature database with abstracts, open full texts, patents, and citation data, built around the PubMed Central corpus and served through an open REST API.

name: MedlinePlus
description: MedlinePlus is the National Library of Medicine consumer health portal covering health topics, drugs, supplements, genetics, medical tests, and a medical encyclopedia.

name: NCBI Bookshelf
description: NCBI Bookshelf offers free online access to books and documents in life sciences and healthcare, including clinical guidelines, textbooks, and the GeneReviews series.

name: DailyMed
description: DailyMed is the official source of current drug labeling information for products marketed in the United States, with structured product labels and search tools.

name: RxNav
description: RxNav is a browser and API for RxNorm, the National Library of Medicine standardized nomenclature for clinical drugs, linking names, ingredients, brands, and dose forms.

name: UMLS Terminology Services
description: The UMLS Terminology Services provides search, download, and API access to the Unified Medical Language System metathesaurus and associated vocabularies under a free license agreement.

name: Cochrane Library
description: The Cochrane Library is a collection of evidence databases, including the Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, with free abstracts and subscription full texts.

name: Trip Database
description: Trip Database is a clinical search engine that ranks results by evidence level, from systematic reviews and guidelines to cohort studies, for medical questions.

name: CINAHL Databases
description: The CINAHL databases index nursing and allied health literature, including journals, books, dissertations, and conference proceedings; full access is by institutional subscription.

name: APA PsycInfo
description: APA PsycInfo indexes behavioral science and mental health literature across journals, books, and dissertations from the 1800s to the present; access is by subscription.

name: Embase
description: Embase is a biomedical literature database with strong coverage of drug, pharmacology, and conference research; access is by subscription from Elsevier.

name: LILACS
description: LILACS is the Latin American and Caribbean Health Sciences Literature index maintained by BIREME, covering regional journals with links to open full texts.

name: WHO IRIS
description: WHO IRIS is the World Health Organization institutional repository, providing open access to WHO publications, guidelines, reports, and articles.

name: IRIS PAHO
description: IRIS PAHO is the institutional repository of the Pan American Health Organization, holding PAHO publications, technical documents, and country cooperation materials.

name: CDC Stacks
description: CDC Stacks is the digital archive of public health publications produced by Centers for Disease Control and Prevention authors, including MMWR articles and CDC journals.
publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

name: Global Index Medicus
description: The WHO Global Index Medicus aggregates regional medical indexes to provide access to biomedical and public health literature produced in low and middle income countries.
best_for: low and middle income country literature

name: Epistemonikos
description: Epistemonikos is a database of health evidence that indexes systematic reviews and primary studies and links each review to the trials underlying it.

name: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality
description: The Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality publishes evidence reports, patient safety resources, and health services research tools for United States healthcare.
publisher: US Department of Health and Human Services

name: NLM Catalog
description: NLM Catalog provides bibliographic records for journals, books, and audiovisuals in the National Library of Medicine collection, including detailed MEDLINE journal metadata.

name: MMWR
description: The Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report is the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention serial publication of public health surveillance findings and recommendations.
publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

name: NICE Guidance
description: NICE Guidance publishes evidence-based recommendations on clinical care, public health, and technology appraisal for the United Kingdom National Health Service.
publisher: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence

name: US Preventive Services Task Force
description: The US Preventive Services Task Force publishes evidence-based recommendations on preventive services, including screenings and counseling, for United States primary care.

name: The Community Guide
description: The Community Guide publishes findings from Community Preventive Services Task Force systematic reviews of the effectiveness of public health interventions in the United States.

name: ClinicalTrials.gov
description: ClinicalTrials.gov is the United States registry and results database for clinical studies of human participants, maintained by the National Library of Medicine.

name: WHO International Clinical Trials Registry Platform
description: The WHO International Clinical Trials Registry Platform sets registration standards and runs a search portal aggregating records from WHO network primary registries.

name: Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS)
description: The Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) is the European Medicines Agency single entry point for clinical trial applications and public trial information in the EU and EEA.
best_for: EU trial applications and public records

name: ISRCTN
description: ISRCTN is a primary clinical trial registry that assigns unique identifiers to study registrations worldwide and publishes public records with results where supplied.

name: Clinical Trials Registry India
description: The Clinical Trials Registry India is the national registry run under the Indian Council of Medical Research, offering prospective registration for clinical trials in India.
status_notes: Official domain is ctri.nic.in; HTTPS reachability not live-checked in this session.

name: jRCT
description: jRCT is the Japan Registry of Clinical Trials, a unified platform for registering interventional trials, observational studies, and regenerative medicine research in Japan.
publisher: National Institute of Public Health, Japan

name: Netherlands Trial Register
description: The Netherlands Trial Register is the Dutch registry for prospective registration of clinical trials, including trials with non-drug interventions.

name: Brazilian Clinical Trials Registry (ReBEC)
description: The Brazilian Clinical Trials Registry (ReBEC) is Brazil's primary registry of clinical trials, with records in Portuguese, English, and Spanish.
status_notes: Official domain is ensaiosclinicos.gov.br; not live-checked in this session.

name: Chinese Clinical Trial Registry (ChiCTR)
description: The Chinese Clinical Trial Registry (ChiCTR) is a primary registry in China accepting prospective registration of clinical trials and observational studies.

name: Clinical Research Information Service (CRIS)
description: The Clinical Research Information Service (CRIS) is the Republic of Korea's primary clinical trial registry, operated by the Korea National Institute of Health.

name: Iranian Registry of Clinical Trials (IRCT)
description: The Iranian Registry of Clinical Trials (IRCT) is Iran's primary registry for prospective registration of clinical trials conducted in the country.

name: German Clinical Trials Register (DRKS)
description: The German Clinical Trials Register (DRKS) is the German primary register for prospective clinical trial registration, with records in German and English.
status_notes: Register relaunched at drks.de; older DRKS URLs may redirect; not live-checked in this session.

name: Thai Clinical Trials Registry (TCTR)
description: The Thai Clinical Trials Registry (TCTR) is Thailand's primary registry for prospective registration of clinical trials.

name: EU Clinical Trials Register
description: The EU Clinical Trials Register provides public information on interventional trials authorized under the former EU clinical trials directive; new trials register through CTIS.
status_notes: Legacy register; CTIS (euclinicaltrials.eu) is the current EU system.

name: Be Part of Research
description: Be Part of Research is the National Institute for Health and Care Research service for finding and taking part in clinical trials and health studies in the United Kingdom.
publisher: National Institute for Health and Care Research (NIHR)
